blindSummary: This macro-region bundles the country's two most concrete municipal protections for transgender people with two of the six highest-victim regions in the 2012-2025 violence-monitoring dataset. The country's most populous city runs its first 'gender registry' (chosen name on civic documents, public-transport subscriptions and staff badges) and a second major city runs an analogous alias-identity practice at the municipality and public libraries - practical tools that determine whether a gender-nonconforming visitor is humiliated at a ticket window. Against this, the two regions inside it are named as high-violence areas: a 28-year-old trans woman was found dead in a provincial town (October 2025), linked to a robbery series targeting vulnerable people, and right-wing militants gave fascist-era salutes along a provincial Pride route (September 2025). The institutional responses are notably prompt: the national police's forensic unit brought charges with wiretaps and confessions in the killing, and the political police moved pre-emptively and reported the Pride attack 'struck out at birth'. The larger region's 2015 'natural family' motion and rejection of WHO sex-ed standards are dated climate signals with no visitor-facing enforcement mechanism.
blindSourceSummaries: Lifestyle-site report: the council of the country's most populous city approved the country's first 'gender registry' (motion by the first transgender woman elected to that council, 2022), granting a chosen name on civic and municipal documents, public-transport subscriptions and staff badges; a second major city introduced an analogous alias-identity practice at its municipality and public libraries. These are the practical, visitor-facing administrative tools named for this unit.

Region-by-region study of anti-LGBT hate-motivated violence 2012-2025: names the six highest-victim regions of the country; the two regions inside this macro-region are two of the six (the other four lie in other macro-regions). Basis of the high-violence attribution for this unit.

Local news report: a 28-year-old transgender woman was found dead in her flat in a provincial town on 9 October 2025; on 22 December 2025 the national police's forensic unit charged and jailed two men aged 22 and 25 - already imprisoned for a series of violent robberies against vulnerable people - linking them to the killing through wiretaps and a confession. Recorded as a prompt, well-run institutional response inside a documented robbery pattern targeting fragile people.

Regional news report (27 September 2025): right-wing militants were filmed giving fascist-era salutes along a provincial Pride parade route; the political police moved pre-emptively against the organisers and reported the attack 'struck out at birth' - an attempted anti-Pride action neutralised before it escalated.
blindTangential: The macro-region's larger region made a 2015 regional-council motion 'in support of the natural family' and against 'gender ideology', and rejected the WHO sexuality-education standards - a durable political-climate signal against LGBT+ rights generally, with no visitor-facing enforcement mechanism.
